prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Offshore wind O&M; scope Grid Interface Relay (Wildmere); excludes public grid, port ops. Wildmere: Export Limit Advisory→Grid Dispatcher when capability<target; applies accepted ceiling, Grid Constraint response; keeps protection settings unless authorized switching plan. Grid Dispatcher: requirements→Wildmere. Priority: safety>protection>export, in all degraded modes. Turbine Controller (Glassfin): validated commands, blocks conflicts, local protection on supervisory loss, safe mode on auxiliary loss, shutdown on fire; Pitch Deviation Notice. Pitch System, Rotor Brake Unit, Converter Cabinet (isolated on fire/overheat), Nacelle Condition Monitor→Turbine Sensor Bus. Mode Turbine Lockout: until fault assessed, work authorized; no remote restart during fire investigation. Offshore Substation (Morrowick): Main Transformer, export cable, Export Cable Monitor, station service transformers, Fire Detection Panel; Transformer Tap Snapshot→Shore Control Room; Switching Window Acknowledgment; mode Substation Degraded. Substation Operator switches only in window with Control Engineer authorization, notifies Grid Dispatcher. Emergency Generator (Foxglove): auto-start on auxiliary loss, no unapproved paralleling; Start Test Trace; it and Fire Detection Panel never bypassed. SCADA Gateway (Juniper Vale): telemetry/alarms→Shore Control Room (Amber Quay); Session Revocation Receipt→Cybersecurity Gateway. Shore Control Room keeps last validated limit on comms loss; applies concept. Operations Radio Console: voice to CTV, SOV, Daughter Craft; Vessel Master read-back; Transfer Manifest Addendum from Duty Planner. Personnel Tracking Console; HSE Officer; Field Supervisor; Marine Coordinator; Electrical Technician; Work Permit Portal. North/South Access Scanners deny unauthorized, no override; East/West Service Lifts interlocks never bypassed. Modes: Weather Hold (Weather Service, Weather Analyst); Vessel Standby. Degraded: record, escalate; Control Engineer suspends unconfirmed remote commands; Fleet Dispatch Console→Duty Planner; Maintenance Planning Engine. Recovery: inspections before automatic control; SCADA Engineer verifies consistent status/alarms/feedback across views; Duty Planner updates priorities after confirmation; staged restoration; event record retained. Governance: controlled baseline; Asset Operator assigns document owner (periodic/change-triggered review); changes need impact assessment (safety, marine, electrical, availability, cyber, regulatory); roles incl. Cybersecurity Analyst review; evidence in controlled repositories; nonconformances get owner, due date, closure evidence.

New part:
S977: Review findings are assessed for their effect on existing procedures, training, interfaces, and resource requirements.
S978: Proposed revisions are checked by affected operational and technical representatives before submission to the designated approver.
S979: The approver confirms that comments are resolved or explicitly accepted before the revised baseline is released.
S980: Released revisions identify the change, rationale, approval, effective date, and superseded baseline.
S981: Personnel affected by a revision receive appropriate communication or training before the change takes effect.
S982: Unapproved local variations are not treated as changes to the operating concept and are escalated through established governance channels.
S983: The operator periodically evaluates whether assurance arrangements provide sufficient evidence that the concept remains effective.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
